title: mutastic's additions to mutation.json, v1
description: mutation.json follows the mutation-testing report schema (version 2), which other tools read. What mutastic knows beyond it, what its cards and HTML report show, is under one `mutastic` key: at the top level for the run, and on each mutant for that mutant. Both editions write the same. Every field is optional: a field is left out when there's nothing to say. Fields may be added within v1: read what you know. See https://docs.mutastic.io/reference/schemas/.

commands.description: The commands for one mutant, as the run's own output writes them for this project and as mutastic was started (the command line, a Maven goal, a Gradle task, cargo), with `<id>` where the mutant's id goes. Without `passes`, which the cards add after `verify`.

verify.description: Proves a test now catches it: `mutastic verify <id> samples/pricing`.

run.description: Runs it again on its own: `mutastic run --only=<id> samples/pricing`.

ignore.description: Records it as not worth a test, with a reason: `mutastic ignore <id> --reason="<why>" samples/pricing`.

propose.description: What a coding agent offers instead of ignoring: a proposal for a person to accept.

docsBase.description: The docs of the mutastic that ran, ending in `/`: `https://docs.mutastic.io/`.

operatorDocs.description: For each operator in the report (by its `mutatorName`) that the docs describe, where, relative to `docsBase`.

score.description: The mutation score, as the run reported it, to one decimal place; null when nothing was scored.

threshold.description: The score the run had to reach.

passed.description: Whether the run passed, as its exit code says: on the threshold, or with `--fail-on-new` on new misses.

toolchain.description: What built and ran the tests: `jdk` 17, `rustc` 1.94.0.

startedAt.description: When the run started, in UTC.

mutant.description: What the mutant's card says beyond the report schema's fields.

method.description: Where the change is, as the source names it: `Pricing.discount()`, `Pricing::discount()`.

evidence.description: For a missed mutant, what the tests did, a sentence each, backticks marking code: the card's evidence lines.

fix.description: For a missed mutant, the test to write, in a sentence: the card's fix line.

inputs.description: The values each parameter of the method had while the tests ran it, by parameter name.

suggestedTest.description: A test that catches the mutant, found by running the method: the card's test to add.

testClass.description: Where it goes: the test class, or Rust's test module.

withMutant.description: What it gives with the mutant.

arguments.description: The value it passes each parameter, by name.

nearUnsafe.description: The Rust edition only: why the mutant is near unsafe code, as the events say it (`inside unsafe code`, …). A crash there isn't counted as caught.

failureOrigin.description: For a caught mutant, where the failure came from: `assertion` (a check failed), `test` (the test's own code threw), `code` (the code under test threw) or `unknown`.
